prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection to Build Emotional Investment: Shift sign-in step to occur after users choose and personalize their desktop pet. Users complete adoption first, making them far more motivated to sign in and save progress. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning. Moving authentication after adoption builds motivation before asking for credentials.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Live Interactive Stage Redesign for Pet Selection: Redesign the pet pick screen into an animated showcase stage with instant preview animations and preset choice cards. (why: Adoption stage has a high dropoff (60.9% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s) and support emails note custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Clear Account Continuity Copy on Sign-In: Add clear copy emphasizing that signing in protects pet save states and prevents accidental pet resets. (why: Users confuse new guest sessions with existing accounts, resulting in support tickets about lost pets after re-signing in.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Split Card Layout with Direct Path Recommendations: Reformat the path selection screen into side-by-side split comparison cards highlighting estimated setup times. (why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s and drops ~24% of users right at the first choice.)
4: [finish, notification] Audio Chime and Desktop Active Badge on Completion: Play a welcoming chime and show an active overlay badge on final onboarding screen when pet renders on the screen. (why: 3 support emails report pets failing to show up on desktop or users not realizing the app opened.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in post-adoption leverages motivation but requires significant flow refactoring.
Targeting the largest dropoff stage backed by both long funnel times and support ticket complaints.
Low-cost copy change directly addressing support confusion around guest accounts.
Helps resolve high mean duration (514s) at the first step via clearer path layout.
Directly resolves reported issue of users not realizing app completion via audio/visual feedback.
